faqs.question: Who can participate in Internal SIH 2026?
faqs.answer: All enrolled students from Vidush Somany Institute of Technology & Research (VSITR), Kadi across IT, CSE, and CE departments (Semesters 1-8) are eligible to participate.

faqs.question: Is it compulsory to have a female team member?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every team MUST include at least 1 female participant. All-girls teams are also fully welcome and eligible.

faqs.question: Can I register without a mentor initially?
faqs.answer: Yes! Registration is conducted in two phases. In Phase 1, you complete your 6-member Team Registration before the deadline. In Phase 2, you can submit your Mentor Details using your Team ID.

faqs.question: What happens if my team name already exists?
faqs.answer: Team names must be unique across the institute. If your chosen team name is already taken, the registration portal will prompt you to choose another unique name.

faqs.question: Can I edit my team details after submission?
faqs.answer: Post-submission changes to team members or details are not allowed through the portal. Any critical modifications require official approval from the organizing committee.

faqs.question: What if I miss the registration deadline?
faqs.answer: Registrations automatically close on 25 August 2026, 05:29 AM. Late entries will not be entertained under any circumstances.

faqs.question: How will I receive further updates?
faqs.answer: All official updates, screening schedules, and problem statement announcements will be communicated exclusively to the Team Leader via their registered college email and the official WhatsApp group.

faqs.question: Can members be from different departments or semesters?
faqs.answer: Yes! Members can be from different departments (IT, CSE, CE) and different semesters/years, provided all 6 members belong to VSITR.

faqs.question: How do I log back in to see my team status?
faqs.answer: Click "Team Login" in the navbar and enter your Team ID (e.g. SIH2026-001), Team Name, and Team Leader Email ID to access your dedicated Team Portal.

faqs.question: I forgot my Team ID — how do I recover it?
faqs.answer: Check the confirmation email sent to your Team Leader upon registration, or reach out to your club student coordinators with your team leader enrollment number.

rules.text: Each team must consist of exactly 6 members, including the Team Leader.
Each team must include at least 1 female participant. All-girls teams are welcome and eligible.
All participants must be from the same college (VSITR) — inter-college teams are not permitted.
Members may belong to different years, branches, or disciplines within the same college (IT, CSE, CE).
Each team must use a unique team name that does NOT include the institute's name (e.g. VSITR, Vidush Somany).
Each participant (by enrollment number) may be part of only one team.
A team once registered cannot add/replace members after the registration deadline without admin approval.
Registration is split into two independent phases: (a) Team Registration and (b) Mentor Details Submission. Phase (a) must be completed by deadline; Phase (b) is mandatory for final confirmation.
Only the Team Leader may register the team and will be the sole point of contact for all official communication.
All communication (screening schedules, problem statements, presentation dates, selection updates) will be sent only to the Team Leader's registered college email.
Teams must report on time for screening rounds/presentations as per the schedule communicated via email.
Plagiarism, misrepresentation of information, or providing false enrollment/contact details will lead to disqualification.
Decisions of the organizing committee (Research, Coding, Design, Soft Skills clubs) and faculty coordinators are final and binding.
Any change in team composition or mentor after submission must be communicated to the organizing committee in writing/email — not self-editable post-deadline.
